title: How Carrick's Man Utd are shaping up for Premier League season

content: As Manchester United prepare to start the new Premier League season at Hull on Saturday, BBC Sport examines how Michael Carrick's team will set up tactically.

title: Wrexham's Moore aiming to stay the distance

content: The striker has revealed he has taken "measures" to avoid the injury issues that hit his Wales and Wrexham hopes last season
